notes:
WI-16 (UC-009 web) — SuperAdmin /admin/platform Platform analytics screen. Strict red-green-refactor TDD, test ordering pure modules -> hook -> component -> axe.

== DELIVERABLES ==
- GET /api/v1/admin/analytics client contract in client.ts: interfaces FleetHealthRow, PlatformTotals, AdminAnalyticsResponse (camelCase byte-for-byte mirror of GetPlatformAnalyticsResponse/FleetHealthRowDto/PlatformTotalsDto), + getAdminAnalytics(). BARE envelope { fleets, totals } (confirmed against backend record — NOT an { items } wrapper; no unwrap needed, matches getAnalyticsOverview style).
- useAdminAnalytics.ts: TanStack Query hook, hierarchical key ['admin','analytics'], staleTime 30s, retry false (mirrors useAdminFleets).
- PlatformScreen.tsx: per-fleet health table (fleet name, rides this/last month, MoM %, revenue this month, active drivers/customers, SMS count + est. cost, last order, 12-week SVG sparkline, health chip) + platform totals row (table tfoot AND a totals card grid) + CSV export. Loading / error (role=alert) / empty states. Route /admin/platform wrapped in AdminGuard; nav link added from AdminFleetsPage title bar.

== PURE MODULES (TDD bottom of ladder) ==
- sparklinePath.ts (sparklinePoints): pure SVG polyline point-string builder. 5 tests (empty, single-point midline, inverted y-axis spread, proportional scaling, flat midline for all-equal).
- healthBand.ts (healthBand): DISPLAY-BAND mapper only — consumes server row.health directly, maps to { labelKey, colorToken }. Does NOT recompute the band from momDeltaPct (per advisor: that would duplicate server logic and diverge on inactive-precedence). growing->success, stable->textSecondary, declining->error, inactive->warning; unknown falls back to stable. 5 tests.
- platformCsv.ts (buildPlatformCsv): reuses shared toCsv (BOM + ';' + CRLF + RFC-4180). Money emitted as RAW integer CZK (no separators). i18n-dependent cell formatters (health label, last-order date) injected by caller. 3 byte-tests (BOM/;/CRLF, header+data row exact, delimiter quoting).

== CHUNK PLACEMENT DECISION (key) ==
Used an inline SVG sparkline, NOT Chart.js. PlatformScreen lives in features/admin/ (its natural home for a SuperAdmin /admin route). Reason: vite manualChunks force-routes chart.js/react-chartjs-2 into the 'analytics' chunk; importing react-chartjs-2 from an admin file would create a hard admin->analytics chunk dependency, dragging the ~95 KB FleetAdmin analytics chunk into the SuperAdmin admin chunk for a single sparkline. SVG avoids the coupling entirely and is the WI's sanctioned fallback ('small Chart.js Line OR SVG sparkline / a lightweight sparkline'). Verified: PlatformScreen built as its own lazy chunk (PlatformScreen-*.js, ~10 KB raw, zero chart.js); analytics-*.js unchanged at 94.77 KB brotli (baseline 94.72 — no leak).

== SIZE BUDGET ==
No new dependency added (chart.js/react-chartjs-2 already present from WI-12). No manualChunks/budget change needed. size-limit: app js 219.71 KB / 260 limit (was 216.94; +2.77 KB for the admin analytics DTOs/hook/screen/csv/sparkline, which land in the lazy PlatformScreen chunk counted under the app-js glob's non-analytics set); analytics chunk 94.77 KB / 115 limit. Both pass.

== A11Y ==
SVG sparkline: role='img' + i18n aria-label 'admin.platform.sparklineLabel' with fleet name; focusable=false; polyline uses currentColor. Table has an sr-only <caption> (styled visually-hidden) + scope='col' headers. Totals numeric-only tfoot cells that carry no label are aria-hidden. axe assertion on the rendered screen passes (via configured helper).

CONTRAST FIX (advisor-caught, jsdom-axe-blind): the health chip originally hard-set white (textOnPrimary) foreground on ALL band backgrounds. The inactive band background is 'warning' #f9ab00 (amber); white-on-amber is ~1.9:1 and FAILS WCAG (jsdom axe has color-contrast disabled per CLAUDE.md, so it never saw this; Lighthouse AC#10 / reviewer would). Fix: healthBand now returns a PAIRED foreground token fgToken alongside colorToken, mirroring the codebase status-pill convention (statusBusy #f9ab00 pairs with statusBusyText #202124). growing/stable/declining -> textOnPrimary (white; all >=6:1); inactive -> text (#202124 dark on amber). Chip renders color={theme.colors[fgToken]}. Enforced by unit test (healthBand.test.ts asserts each fgToken) since axe cannot check contrast in jsdom. TDD'd RED->GREEN.

== I18N ==
New block admin.platform.* added to BOTH cs.json and en.json (parity test green): title, subtitle, loading, loadFailed, empty, backToFleets, exportCsv, csvFilename, noOrders, sparklineLabel, columns.{fleet,ridesThisMonth,ridesLastMonth,momDelta,revenueThisMonth,activeDrivers,activeCustomers,sms,smsCost,lastOrder,trend,health}, health.{growing,stable,declining,inactive}, totals.{title,fleets,rides,revenue,growing,declining,inactive}. Money formatted at render with Intl.NumberFormat('cs-CZ'); lastOrderAt formatted in Europe/Prague, null -> 'Bez objednávek'/'No orders'.

== INCIDENTAL EDITS ==
AdminFleetsPage.tsx: added a Link to /admin/platform in the title bar (WI 'nav/route wiring within /admin'). This required wrapping the AdminFleetsPage.test.tsx wrapper in MemoryRouter (Link needs router context) — 4 existing tests updated, still green.

== REACHABILITY CAVEAT (mirrors AdminFleetsPage precedent) ==
Reaching /admin requires a SuperAdmin JWT the backend cannot mint today (no SuperAdmin login path — documented in client.ts). The screen hits the real /admin/analytics route so tsc/build/tests stay green and is otherwise complete; end-to-end reachability is an api-lane gap, not a WI-16 defect. Did not chase a login path (out of scope).

== ERROR PATH (last-known-state) ==
WI-16 error path is 'query error -> last-known + inline error'. The screen renders the ErrorText banner (role=alert) inline while STILL showing the last-known table/totals when TanStack holds a prior successful fetch. First-load failure (no data) shows only the banner. This satisfies rules/web-realtime.md#last-known-state. The PlatformScreen error test asserts the banner on a rejected first-load (no last-known), which is the mocked path; the last-known-on-refetch behavior is by construction (data && isError both render).

== DEVIATIONS ==
None material. Chose SVG over Chart.js sparkline (WI-sanctioned alternative, advisor-endorsed for chunk hygiene). No masking concerns here (platform screen shows fleet names only, no customer PII). Health-chip foreground was changed from a uniform white to a per-band paired token to fix an amber-band contrast failure (see A11Y section) — a strengthening of the design, not a spec deviation.
